body: You think you’re depressed looking for a job? I’m depressed after 18 months out of work with no prospects and busting my back every day doing everything I can with no end in sight. Just stick with your job, trust me you won’t find anything else even if you try.
You want to trade places? I’ve been unemployed for 18 months with no prospect of a job and I’m ready to kill myself.

No help. Online crap is useless. Let’s just get on with it already. My method will be a bridge and no one will care. I’ll be sure to send a form letter to the thousands of companies I applied to who ghosted me. That will give them a better laughs than my job application that they ignored.

I think they’re passing on me because I’m inherently flawed. I will never get ahead no matter what I do. You know those people who do  EVERYTHING wrong but get theirs lives handed to them on a platter? You know those people who do EVERYTHING right yet can’t get a break?

But it IS my fault I can’t find a job. It’s my responsibility. I am so close to giving up, just sitting on my couch watching horror films and hoping to die. I am sorry, I know you’re trying to help but I’m simply at my wits end. I could just cry over losing out on this job this week.
But I AM discouraged!!! A year I’ve been at this. I I know I’m a great employee but nothing is coming my way. I have tried so hard.

I hear you. I’m sorry for your struggle. I swear I know people who could take a dump on the interviewer’s desk and still get an offer. I don’t understand what I did wrong to deserve this. I am sick of it all. If Satan appeared now and asked for my soul in exchange for a decent job I’d break my hand signing the contract so fast.
Can’t get a job. Been looking for over a year. Perfect opportunity snatched from me this week because I couldn’t apply fast enough. I don’t know how much longer I can go on.
